one_liner: Supervisory case management role leading service coordinators who connect people with developmental disabilities and their families to Medicaid waiver and community services.
fit_summary: This is a senior clinical casework and supervisory position in developmental disabilities. Roles like this typically require a human services degree and DD case management experience, neither of which is on file for Daniel. Daniel's people skills, policy knowledge, and work with government clients are real assets, but they likely won't meet the clinical qualifications.
eligibility: Verify the minimum qualifications in the full posting (text is truncated). Service Coordinator III roles usually require a human services degree plus several years of DD case management experience.
Check whether supervisory experience is required, since the posting calls this a supervisory position.
Confirm any Virginia DBHDS knowledge, skills and abilities expectations for DD case managers.
Open to the public (local government, no federal status needed). Grant-funded, so confirm funding duration.
